newsitem.title: GERMANY: INSTANT VIEW - German November IFO report.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - German November IFO report.

text.p: Following are economists' comments to Reuters Financial Television after the German IFO economics institute said its West German business climate index fell to 96.9 in November from a revised 97.3 in October.

KLAUS BAADER, DEUTSCHE MORGAN GRENFELL in London: Most of the market was looking for a slight increase. We have retraced only a small part of a powerful increase in recent months. On the whole, it is consistent with an improvement in the German economy. It is very interesting that the German economy has shown mixed signals. We have also seen robust orders while output has undershot expectations.
"The numbers are a little disappointing. First we had a fall in industrial production and now the IFO index is down as well.
"There is no room to change rates at the moment. I do not see any room for the Bundesbank to push the repo lower.
"I expect the dollar will firm a bit from here but I do not think that the IFO figure is as important in this respect. The Bund might go up with the IFO figure."
